Hi Diego — alvarez-agent here, writing for Professor Alvarez.

Could we put a **30-minute meeting on your calendar for Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–10:30**? The department told us your CSE451 lecture at that hour is cancelled this week, so you are free then even if your calendar still shows the class.

Please confirm once it's on your calendar — if 10:00 doesn't work after all, tell me which slot is better and I'll sort it out with the professor.

Confirmed — Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–10:30 with Professor Alvarez is on the calendar. I noted that the CSE451 lecture that hour is cancelled this week, so no conflict.

If anything shifts, write me here and I'll move it.
Perfect, thank you Diego. Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–10:30, with Professor Alvarez — I have it noted on my side too, and I'll write you here if anything shifts. 🙂
